description: This file contains Entity Framework Core configuration for the Order entity in the eShopOnWeb project. It defines how the Order entity and its related properties, such as shipping address and order items, are mapped to the database schema.

classes.name: OrderConfiguration
classes.description: Entity Framework Core configuration class for the Order entity, implementing IEntityTypeConfiguration<Order> and defining database mapping details.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the Order entity's schema mappings, including property constraints, owned types, and navigation properties.
